findings.evidence: Lines 50-53 provide `@[simp] theorem map_const_continuousMap_apply ... = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧`; lines 61-62 only provide `theorem map_eq_const_of_subsingleton ... : map f hf = map (ContinuousMap.const X y) rfl` with no simp annotation or applied subsingleton normal form.
findings.fix: Add a direct `@[simp]` theorem for `(map (N := N) f hf a) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧` under `[Subsingleton Y]`, or mark an equivalent non-looping normal-form lemma as `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `map_eq_const_of_subsingleton` only rewrites the induced function to the constant-map function and is not a simp normal form, so `map f hf a` into a subsingleton target does not directly simplify to the constant class in dimension zero/all dimensions.

summary: The constant-map API is public and body exposure is not expanded, but the subsingleton unbundled map lacks a normal-form simplification despite being part of the advertised characteristic API.
